title: How to Get a 300 Combo in Project P.I.T.T. — x300 Achievement Guide
description: Operational steps to earn the MEGA! x300 combo in Project P.I.T.T.: build one reliable feed lane with a short visible recoverable section, keep product arrival continuous, test MORE! x100 and EXTRA! x200 runs first, use Automation and the Shift Scheduler to maintain flow, and time the final attempt before any ending progression.
h1: How to Get a 300 Combo in Project P.I.T.T. — x300 Achievement Guide
quickAnswer: Build one reliable feed lane with a short visible recoverable section, keep arrivals continuous and avoid gaps, store a safety margin above exactly 300 products, test MORE! x100 and EXTRA! x200 first, use Automation and the Shift Scheduler to sustain flow, and prioritize the attempt before final-ending progression to prevent jams and resets.

facts.label: x300 target
facts.value: Progression names: MORE! x100, EXTRA! x200, MEGA! x300. Maintain a safety margin above exactly 300 products so the combo does not fall short during the final release.

facts.label: Practice milestones
facts.value: Test runs at x100 and x200 before attempting x300. Build one reliable feed lane, keep product arrival continuous, and avoid gaps that reset the combo. Use a short visible recoverable lane to spot and recover small interruptions quickly.

facts.label: Automation
facts.value: Use Automation and the Shift Scheduler to keep feed timing consistent, reduce manual gaps, and flag potential jams before they affect the lane. Automation helps sustain continuous arrival during an x300 attempt.

facts.label: Timing
facts.value: Prioritize the x300 attempt before any final-ending progression as a precaution. Prevent jams before the final release, maintain continuous arrival without gaps, and rely on the short visible recoverable lane to correct small disruptions.
